title: Answer: the mind is observed by neuroscience and psychology, with introspection as fallible theory

statements.text: The view takes no position on measurement in physics. The mind is observed by the methods of neuroscience and experimental psychology. Introspection is not privileged observation: it is theory-laden and often confabulated.

sources.quote: the naturalness of our self-appraisal and our explanations ‘from the inside’ can easily be mistaken for privileged access
